verdict.rationale: The vendor documents a free developer tier: a dev instance of up to 4 vCPU and 8 GB RAM with no credit card required. Its docs describe a self-serve path from signup to first query in about five minutes (create a cluster, connect any ClickHouse client, load data, query), which removes the need for a sales call. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the free tier, and documentation of free-tier limits such as storage, duration, or data-volume caps that determine whether an analyst can evaluate at real-data scale.
